sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Padmashree R.P. is a Bengaluru poet and teacher trainer. Her public writing brings poetry into conversation with education, while her contribution here attends to the ways affection and knowledge pass between generations.

‘Love’s Simplicity’ moves between the body, family memory and the natural world. Rivers, blood, parents’ songs and children form a chain of shared experience. Its recurring short passages give the poem a gentle, reflective rhythm, presenting love as something learned through attention and companionship.
